discovery_notes: Follow-up 3 of B018 (after 218/426/467). 30 standard WebSearch queries, blocked domains passed every time, all search_snippet. Evidence mainly Disney Pins Blog weekly roundups plus one Disney Diary article and one MPC page. Reseller-only facts (yourwdwstore, coastalpinmagic) not recorded. A Pin & Pop mention surfaced in one summary and was ignored. New: TIE Fighter and A-Wing vehicle pins, Snow White 80th parks set, Nov Last Jedi surprise pins, Kilimanjaro PODH, Doorways Alice/Peter Pan, Goofy 85th, POTC DMTNT, Essence of Evil Evil Queen/Yzma, Thanksgiving and Christmas 2017, WDW variants for Darling and Dashing and Haunting Halloween Gus.
